title: Admin automation settings, dynamic brand image, and editorial theme refresh

requirements.summary: Add an admin-only Automation Settings screen to manage ingestion sources, trigger ingestion, and view ingestion status/errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Only authorized admins can access the automation settings screen (reuse existing admin guard patterns).
Admin can add/edit/enable/disable/remove content sources from the UI.
Admin can click "Run ingestion now" and see a success/error result in the UI.
The UI displays last run time and basic ingestion stats returned from the backend.

file_operations.description: Create an owner/admin-only automation settings page that uses the existing admin-guard pattern (useAdminGuard + AccessDeniedScreen) from the authorization component to protect access, and provides: (1) CRUD UI for content sources (name, URL, default category, enabled flag, and image rule fields), (2) a "Run ingestion now" action wired to the backend trigger, and (3) a status/errors panel fed by backend-provided ingestion run info. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query hooks/mutations for: fetching sources list, creating/updating/deleting sources, triggering a run-now action, and querying last-run stats + recent errors for the status panel; ensure queries are invalidated after mutations and show errors via existing UI patterns (e.g., FormStatusBanner).
Register and wire a new admin-only route (e.g., /owner/automation) that renders AutomationSettingsPage, keeping all existing routes/navigation intact and not removing any routes.

Update frontend backend interface typings to match the automation settings needs: IngestionSource fields (name, url, defaultCategory, enabled, imageRule, id) and add typed return shapes for ingestion status (last run time/outcome/counts + recent errors) used by the UI. This is a frontend-only type alignment step anticipating backend capabilities.

requirements.summary: Replace hardcoded logo usage with a backend-configured brand image, with safe fallbacks and admin update support.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes admin-only methods to set/update a brand image reference (at minimum a URL string, optionally backed by stored asset bytes using existing storage mixins).
Frontend header logo uses the backend-configured brand image reference, with a safe fallback to the existing static logo if none is configured or load fails.
Brand image can be updated by an admin without redeploying the frontend.

file_operations.description: Create a React Query hook to load the backend-configured BrandImage (and optionally a mutation helper to update it) and expose loading/error states for use in header/admin UI.

Replace the hardcoded logo src with the backend-configured brand image from useBrandImage; implement robust fallback to the existing static logo at frontend/public/assets/generated/site-logo.dim_512x128.png when unset or when the image fails to load.

Extend the admin-only Automation Settings screen to include a small brand image configuration panel that updates the backend-configured brand image (URL and related fields), enabling brand image updates without redeploying the frontend; reuse the authorization component's admin guard pattern. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive editorial-style visual theme refresh (warm neutrals, high-contrast typography, subtle paper-like surfaces) across key pages without changing structure or routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Colors/typography/spacing feel consistent across header, footer, cards, and page sections.
No routes are removed; existing navigation remains intact.
Theme avoids blue/purple as the primary brand palette.

file_operations.description: Refresh global theme tokens toward warm neutrals and paper-like surfaces (background/card/muted/border), increase typographic contrast, and adjust chart/utility color tokens away from blue/purple primaries while keeping Tailwind/shadcn token conventions intact.

Adjust/extend Tailwind theme settings (e.g., shadows/radius/typography defaults) to support an editorial look (subtle elevation, paper surfaces) while continuing to rely on existing CSS variables for core color tokens.
Update hero/section styling to match the editorial theme (paper-like surfaces, warm neutral gradients, refined spacing/typography) without changing page structure or routes.
Align card styling with the editorial theme (surface, border, shadow, typography), and keep the existing image onError fallback behavior working.

Refine post detail surfaces/typography to match the editorial theme; update the hero image fallback to use the generated wide image at frontend/public/assets/generated/ncert-sample-papers.dim_1600x900.jpg (and continue handling load failures safely).
Adjust layout-level wrappers (header/breadcrumb bar/main/footer spacing and surfaces) to ensure consistent editorial styling across key pages while preserving existing routing/navigation.
